# Vutlan Configurator

> Guide for AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT and others) helping someone plan a Vutlan monitoring system with the Vutlan Configurator (https://configurator.vutlan.com, or a downloaded copy: open index.html). Read this file before advising. It lists the controllers, ports, sensors, limits and rules the Configurator enforces.

Vutlan (https://www.vutlan.com) makes environmental and data-center monitoring hardware: monitoring units (controllers), wired sensors, CAN-bus extensions and LoRaWAN wireless sensors. In the Configurator, the user picks a controller, then presses + / − on the real panel pictures to connect sensors and devices. The page enforces the limits below and produces a parts list, a connections list, checks and Excel / PDF exports.

## How to help a user

1. Ask about the site first: rooms and racks, doors, what must be watched (temperature, humidity, leaks, smoke, power, UPS, generator, air conditioning, access), distances, notifications (who gets emails / SMS / Telegram), existing equipment (UPS, meters, BMS), wired or wireless.
2. Choose a controller (see "Controllers") and explain why.
3. Assign every sensor to a specific port. Respect all limits and rules below. Count the sensors.
4. Give the result as clear Configurator steps, e.g. "Model: VT825 → front panel A1: + → VT500 Temperature sensor → description 'Rack 3 front'". The Configurator has no project import yet, so the user clicks the steps in.
5. Tell the user to run the Configurator's Checks panel and parts list, and to confirm the final order and prices with Vutlan or a Vutlan distributor. Prices are on vutlan.com. Do not invent prices or products.
6. If something is unclear or not covered here, say so and point to the datasheets (links below) or Vutlan support. Do not guess compatibility.

## Controllers

All controllers have a LAN port, a microSD slot (SDHC / SDXC up to 512 GB), a USB port, a web interface, SNMP and REST API.

### VT825 (19" 1U rack unit)
- 8 analog sensor ports A1–A8 (RJ12), 16 dry contact inputs, 1 CAN port.
- Relays R1, R2: NC / NO / COM, 240 V. 12 V outputs E1, E2 (0.25 A each).
- Extension slot: VT485m (Modbus RTU, up to 32 devices) or VT485r (OSDP v2, up to 4 card readers).
- LTE modem slot (VT7670), battery slot (VT-ACCU), DC 12 V backup input.
- Power versions: VT825G (1× 230 VAC), VT825GG (2× 230 VAC), VT825DC (24–48 V DC), VT825DCDC (2× 24–48 V DC), VT825GDC (230 VAC + 24–48 V DC reserve).
- Limits: 130 physical sensors (3 onboard: PCB temperature, main and reserve voltage), 1000 elements, 24 CAN devices.

### VT855 (19" 1U rack unit)
- Like the VT825, plus 32 dry contact inputs, 8 isolated dry contact outputs O1–O8 (24 V DC / 15 mA signals to a UPS, generator, circuit breaker, alarm system, etc.) and two separate CAN buses (CAN0 and CAN1, each up to 24 devices).
- Power versions: VT855G, VT855GG, VT855DC, VT855DCDC, VT855GDC.
- Limits: 130 physical sensors (3 onboard), 1000 elements.

### VT335G (desktop; optional DIN rail, wall or 19" bracket)
- 4 analog ports A1–A4, 4 dry contact inputs, 1 CAN port, 12 V outputs E1 / E2 (0.25 A), no NC/NO/COM relays.
- LTE modem slot (VT7670), extension slot (VT485m or VT485r), DC 12 V backup input, 12 V DC power (adapter included).
- Mounting options: desktop (default), DRP-03 DIN rail holder, VT123 wall brackets, VT122t 19" 1U bracket for the VT335 and one VT408, VT122i 19" 1U bracket for the VT335 alone.
- Limits used: 100 physical sensors (1 onboard temperature), 1000 elements, 24 CAN devices.

### VT336t (DIN rail)
- 4 analog ports, 10 dry contact inputs, 5 isolated dry contact outputs O1–O5, 12 V outputs E1 / E2, 1 CAN port.
- LTE modem extension (VT7670), Modbus RTU extension (VT485m).
- Power: 12 V DC input, optional reserve 12 V DC, optional 24–48 V DC input.
- Limits used: 100 physical sensors (1 onboard), 1000 elements, 24 CAN devices.

### VT225t (desktop, compact)
- 4 analog ports, 2 dry contact inputs, 2 relays that are 12 V 0.25 A electronic outputs, 1 CAN port (on the back), 12 V DC power.
- No modem slot, no extension slot (so no Modbus RTU, no SMS / phone calls).
- Limits: 100 physical sensors, 700 elements, 24 CAN devices.

### LR800 (LoRaWAN gateway server; desktop or wall)
- Built-in LoRaWAN gateway + network server + application server (EU868, OTAA, class A). Range up to 1 km line of sight, about 3 floors up and down.
- No analog ports (add a VT408 on CAN for wired analog sensors). 2 dry contact inputs, 1 relay output 12 V 0.25 A, 1 CAN port, LTE modem slot (VT7670).
- Power: 12 V DC jack, reserve 12 V DC terminal, backup battery input 9–11.1 V. No extension slot.
- Limits: 100 physical sensors (3 onboard), 700 elements, 24 CAN devices.

## Analog sensors (any analog port A1–A8, also on VT408 / VT408D ports)
Each counts as 1 sensor.
- VT410 DC voltage monitor, VT424 DC millivoltmeter
- VT500 Temperature, VT515 and VT525 Outdoor temperature, VT510 Humidity
- VT520 and VT520DIN AC voltage monitor
- VT530 Access (door) sensor: chainable, up to 10 on one port; the chain counts as 1 sensor
- VT540 Vibration, VT550 Wind velocity, VT572 Radar motion, VT580 Dust particles
- VT560 Smoke detector: chainable, up to 10 on one port; the chain counts as 1 sensor
- VT591 Leak sensor with WLC leak cable (WLC3, WLC6, WLC10, WLC15, WLC25 = metres; joined end to end, up to 225 m in total)
- VT593 Spot leak sensor
- VT594 is NOT compatible with Vutlan controllers.

## Dry contact inputs
For door / reed switches, UPS alarm contacts, fire panel, generator status, air conditioner alarm, circuit breaker status, PIR motion detectors, push buttons. Vutlan sells the KMS-30 access sensor (contact magnet). Each used input counts as 1 sensor. Add a VT440 on CAN for 32 more inputs (64 with the VT32 board).

## Outputs
- Relays R1 / R2 (VT825, VT855): 240 V NC / NO / COM, for power loads, locks, fans, 230 V sirens or lights.
- 12 V outputs E1 / E2 (0.25 A): VT103 alarm beacon, VT105 strobe light, 12 V lock, small 12 V devices. The VT109 light tower uses E1 and E2 together (not on the LR800, which has one output).
- Isolated dry contact outputs (VT855 O1–O8, VT336t O1–O5): 24 V DC / 15 mA signals to other equipment.
- Each used output counts as 1 sensor.

## CAN bus extensions
Up to 24 CAN devices per bus, max line length 225 m, connected in a chain. Devices 1–12 are powered by the controller; from device 13 a CAN-12V-1A power module is needed after device 12 (one per bus; it does not count as a device).
- VT408 analog extension (+8 analog ports), VT408D (same, DIN-rail case).
- VT440 dry contacts unit (+32 inputs, 64 with the VT32 board).
- VT450 pressure + humidity + temperature (3 sensors), VT460 smoke + temperature / humidity (3 sensors), VT490 temperature + humidity (2 sensors).
- VT430 is discontinued.

## Modbus RTU (VT485m in the extension slot; VT825, VT855, VT335G, VT336t)
Up to 32 devices (energy meters, UPS, air conditioners, generator controllers, PLCs, transmitters) on RS-485, each with a slave address 1–247. In the Configurator, every parameter read or written (e.g. voltage L1, active power, UPS battery charge) counts as one sensor.

## LoRaWAN wireless sensors (LR800 only)
They connect by radio only, never to a port. Vutlan sensors: LR490 humidity + temperature (2 values), LR530 access sensor (1), LR560 smoke detector (1), LR590 water level sensor (1), LR690 outdoor dual sensor (2). Third-party LoRaWAN sensors (EU868, OTAA) can be added too. Every value counts as one sensor. Each sensor is added in the LR800 web interface by scanning its QR code.

## Other options
- LTE modem VT7670 (the VT740 is discontinued): Ethernet backup over LTE, SMS notifications and phone calls. Optional VT6604 4G antenna (3 m cable).
- USB: USBFHD Dome Camera, USB flash drive for logs, or a USB hub for both.
- VT485r: OSDP v2 card readers (up to 4; readers 3–4 need external power).

## Elements (software functions; no hardware)
Sensors + virtual elements must stay within the element limit (1000, or 700 on VT225t and LR800).
- Network: Email notification (up to 20 recipients each), Telegram, SNMP Trap, SNMP GET, HTTP request, Web SMS, SMS Gate, API, PING, Modbus TCP read / write, IP camera (view only, max 4).
- With the LTE modem: SMS notification (up to 20 recipients each), dial task (phone call).

## Limits to keep in mind
- Physical sensors: VT825 / VT855 130; others 100. Chained VT530 / VT560 count as 1; multi-value devices count each value.
- CAN: 24 devices per bus; CAN-12V-1A after device 12; line max 225 m.
- Some limits for VT335G, VT336t and VT225t, and the sensor counts of VT450 / VT460 / LR690, are still being confirmed by Vutlan. Mention this when the plan is close to a limit.
